description: This file defines a Java class named RequestWrapper, which extends HttpServletRequestWrapper to provide additional functionality such as reading the request body multiple times, buffering input stream data, and possibly enabling request data inspection or modification within a Java Servlet environment.

classes.name: RequestWrapper
classes.description: A custom HTTP servlet request wrapper that buffers the request body, allowing it to be read multiple times, and implements methods to handle input stream and reader access.

methods.name: RequestWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with the original HttpServletRequest object.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a BufferedReader that reads from the buffered request body bytes.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns a ServletInputStream that reads from the buffered request body bytes.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Reads and buffers the entire request body from the original request input stream on first invocation.
